title: Maximum Product Subarray
summary: Find the largest product of a run of neighbouring values. A negative value can turn the smallest product into the largest, so track both the biggest and the smallest product ending at each position.

inputs.name: values
inputs.label: Array values
inputs.note: Whole numbers from -4 to 4 (keeps the product within 32 bits).

anchors.label: Biggest and smallest product ending here
